description: Capture indicators and suspicious behaviours linked to possible cyber espionage activity, especially where data exfiltration is confirmed or strongly suspected. Use this template to structure host, account, and network evidence while triage or investigation is ongoing.
name: Espionage case triage

structure.help: High-level details for quickly orienting responders and intelligence teams.
structure.label: Case overview

structure.help: When suspicious activity was first observed in the environment. ISO 8601 format, for example `2026-04-25T03:42:00Z`.
structure.label: Date first observed

structure.help: Primary system, user, or business unit believed to be targeted. Keep this concise; full scoping can be added in the event report.
structure.label: Primary target

structure.help: One or two sentences describing why this is suspected to be espionage (e.g., focused collection, stealthy persistence, sensitive data access).
structure.label: Short case summary

structure.help: Capture confirmed or suspected data theft indicators. Add as many entries as needed.
structure.label: Exfiltration indicators

structure.help: External destination IP that received suspicious outbound traffic associated with this case.
structure.label: Exfiltration destination IP

structure.help: Domain observed in exfiltration traffic or command-and-control activity tied to possible collection/extraction.
structure.label: Exfiltration or C2 domain

structure.help: Full URL used for staging or exfiltration (for example cloud storage links, webdav paths, API endpoints).
structure.label: Exfiltration URL

structure.help: Estimated volume of data transferred out (for example `12 GB`, `350 MB`, `unknown`). Stored as text because units vary.
structure.label: Estimated exfiltrated data volume

structure.help: Digest, archive, or staged file artifacts that may represent collected/exfiltrated data.
structure.label: Staged archive or collection filename

structure.help: Host and account behaviours commonly linked with espionage tradecraft.
structure.label: Suspicious behavior

structure.help: Hostname where suspicious collection, staging, or beaconing behavior was observed.
structure.label: Affected hostname

structure.help: User account associated with unusual access patterns, suspicious authentication, or data collection activity.
structure.label: Suspicious account

structure.help: Process name or command used for discovery, collection, compression, or covert transfer.
structure.label: Suspicious process or command

structure.help: Registry key, launch item, service, scheduled task, or other persistence indicator linked to this case.
structure.label: Persistence indicator

structure.help: Known or suspected malicious file hash tied to this activity. Prefer SHA-256.
structure.label: Malicious file hash

structure.help: Classification and sharing controls.
structure.label: Classification and attribution

structure.help: Pick one. Override the default if handling requirements differ from `tlp:amber`.
structure.label: TLP

structure.help: Optional. Mark ATT&CK techniques linked to this case, especially collection, credential access, lateral movement, command-and-control, and exfiltration techniques.
structure.label: MITRE ATT&CK technique

structure.help: Optional. Only fill this if evidence quality supports attribution.
structure.label: Suspected threat actor

structure.content: **Follow-up:** if exfiltration is confirmed later, update this event with final scope and evidence references (packet captures, proxy logs, EDR timelines, or case IDs) in an event report.
